faults.title: Power steering failure in cold weather (Mk1)
faults.description: On the 2008-2016 Mk1, the power steering can fail, especially below freezing. Auto Express says it's usually the control unit, but sometimes the steering rack.

faults.title: Melting fuse boxes (Mk1)
faults.description: Mk1 electrical faults can be caused by fuse boxes melting from the high current going through them.

faults.title: Electronic parking brake won't release (Mk1)
faults.description: The electronic parking brake can refuse to release. Sometimes this is just because the driver's seatbelt isn't done up or the clutch isn't fully pressed.

faults.title: Pop-up bonnet and touchy emergency braking (Mk2)
faults.description: On the 2016-2024 Mk2, the active bonnet can deploy after a low-speed animal strike; Auto Express says a dealer reset costs about £400. Owners also often complain the emergency braking is over-sensitive.

faults.title: Many Mk2 recalls
faults.description: VW has recalled the Mk2 16 times, for issues including detaching roof spoilers, collapsing front seat backs, cracking brake discs, overheating starter motors and faulty fuel tanks.
